analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입했으나 MACD 히스토그램은 악화 중. ADX 26.3로 추세는 뚜렷하나 +DI(16.5) 대비 -DI(42.5)가 우위. 5일간 변동률은 +5.81%로 반등했으나 4일 전 -11.06% 급락 이후 되돌림으로 해석. 1,246,000원 스윙 지지선 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has entered oversold territory, but MACD histogram is worsening. ADX at 26.3 indicates a clear trend, yet -DI (42.5) is dominant over +DI (16.5). The 5-day return of +5.81% shows a rebound, but it's interpreted as a retracement after a sharp -11.06% drop 4 days prior. Confirmation at the 1,246,000 KRW swing support level is needed.

· 52주 위치(32.8%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 부근
[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-44681.0974→-51272.9768) + 악화 진단 + 약세 지속 신호

[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 1,246,000원 지지 확인 후 매수 진입 또는 관망 조건 명시
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (1,294,000 KRW) above SMA5 (1,265,600 KRW), below SMA20 (1,619,100 KRW) and SMA50 (1,641,897 KRW): attempting short-term rebound, below mid-term trend.
· Below SMA100 (1,896,738 KRW) and SMA200 (1,466,750 KRW): weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (32.8%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.5→31.4) + entering oversold territory + weak rebound attempt.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-44681.0974→-51272.9768) + worsening diagnosis + signal of continued weakness.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 1,144,423 KRW) + band width at 58.63% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (1,246,000 KRW) + based on Pivot S1 (1,006,333 KRW).
· Swing resistance level (1,890,000 KRW) + expectation of mid-term trend recovery upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.06x vs 5-day average) + normal reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + specify buy entry after confirming 1,246,000 KRW support or wait-and-see.
